protocol.cluster_effect: shared N(0,sigma^2) random logit intercept per colony
protocol.policy_learning: train colonies only; choose query if query arm mean > passive by report
protocol.validation: independent heldout colonies; 2 Bonferroni one-sided 97.5% lower percentile bounds on J_C-J_P, J_C-J_Q; reject only if both positive
protocol.sampling: independent cluster bootstrap; fixed 12 encounters per old report x arm cell
protocol.scientific_scope: No trial serial dependence, animal noncompliance, natural reward variances or heritable costs.

accuracy_note: Nominal mixed-policy gain 0.04 uses p at colony intercept 0; with N(0,0.55^2) random intercept, marginal true gain approximates 0.0395268755. The full Monte Carlo estimator used here is conditional on a separate policy learned from training clusters.
interpretation: The in-sample positive policy gain is selection-optimistic; the held-out dual-comparator criterion is much more demanding, including in a true-positive toy scenario. Zero detections in 200-250 null replications does not prove exact type-I validity, and the observed synthetic detection fractions cannot be used as real bee statistical power.
